description: This Java class defines a validator for RabbitMQ connection specifications within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract protocol validator and implements methods to validate sources, targets, connection type, and URI schemas specific to RabbitMQ (AMQP protocol).

classes.name: RabbitMQValidator
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractProtocolValidator to provide validation logic specific to RabbitMQ connection configurations, including source/target validation and URI scheme validation for AMQP protocols.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RabbitMQValidator.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration of a connection, including enforcement templates and header mappings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration of a connection, including header mappings and address template.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, which is AMQP 0.9.1.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs overall validation of the connection, including URI scheme, source and target configs, and payload mappings.
